{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing)
valid_age_df = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Print the number of valid age entries and the mean
print(f"Number of converted customers with valid age: {len(valid_age_df)}")
print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1 sentinels): {mean_age}")"}
